he.text: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ חָנֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ כִּי־אֵין בָּנוּ מַעֲשִׂים · עֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶסֶד וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ׃

en.text: Our Father, our King! be gracious unto us, and answer us; although we are destitute of good works, yet deal charitably and mercifully with us, and save us.
